required_visuals.title: Text response and language planner
required_visuals.assessment_use: Learners plan reading/viewing and writing responses.

generation_constraints: Plan visual evidence before writing questions.
If a question references a map, graph, table, diagram, source, performance space, or practical setup, the matching visual must be present in required_visuals.
Do not create blank source placeholders unless the task explicitly requires the educator to insert an external source.
Use the visual as assessable evidence: questions must ask learners to read, complete, compare, cite, label, calculate from, or reflect on it.
validation_rules: No learner-facing question may refer to a missing visual.
Every required visual must have a clear assessment role: stimulus, learner workspace, marking evidence, or moderation evidence.
Visuals must match subject, phase, term/content focus, and assessment family.

sections.title: Section A: Integrated Comprehension and Summary
sections.instructions: Read the following text and answer the questions that follow.
sections.stimulus: The advertisement for a new smartphone features a cartoon of a person using the phone to take a selfie. The caption reads, 'Capture life's moments with our new smartphone!'

questions.question: What is the main idea of the advertisement?
memo: The main idea of the advertisement is to promote the new smartphone as a device for capturing life's moments.

questions.question: What is the tone of the advertisement?
memo: The tone of the advertisement is informal and inviting, with a focus on capturing life's moments.

sections.title: Section B: Cartoon, Advertisement, or Infographic Analysis
sections.instructions: Analyze the following infographic and answer the questions that follow.
sections.stimulus: The infographic shows the number of people who use social media platforms. The data is presented in a bar chart.

questions.question: What is the main finding of the infographic?
memo: The main finding of the infographic is that the majority of people use social media platforms.

questions.question: What is the implication of the data presented in the infographic?
memo: The implication of the data presented in the infographic is that social media platforms have a significant impact on people's lives.

sections.title: Section C: Editing for Grammar, Diction, Register, and Punctuation
sections.instructions: Edit the following text to ensure that it is free of grammatical errors and is written in the correct register.
sections.stimulus: The text reads, 'The new smartphone is a great device for taking selfies. It has a good camera and a long battery life.'

questions.question: What is the subject of the sentence?
memo: The subject of the sentence is the new smartphone.

questions.question: What is the verb of the sentence?
memo: The verb of the sentence is 'is'.

sections.title: Section D: Formal Transactional Writing and Controlled Response Planning
sections.instructions: Write a formal letter to the editor of a newspaper in response to the following article.
sections.stimulus: The article reads, 'The new smartphone is a game-changer for the tech industry.'

questions.question: What is the main idea of the article?
memo: The main idea of the article is that the new smartphone is a game-changer for the tech industry.

questions.question: What is the tone of the article?
memo: The tone of the article is formal and informative, with a focus on the impact of the new smartphone on the tech industry.

rubric.descriptor: The learner demonstrates a clear understanding of the text and is able to identify the main idea and supporting details.
The learner is able to analyze the data presented in the infographic and identify the main finding and implication of the data.
The learner is able to edit the text to ensure that it is free of grammatical errors and is written in the correct register.
The learner is able to write a formal letter to the editor of a newspaper in response to the article, demonstrating a clear understanding of the topic and the ability to write in a formal tone.

teacher_review_checklist: Verify that the learner has demonstrated a clear understanding of the text and is able to identify the main idea and supporting details.
Verify that the learner is able to analyze the data presented in the infographic and identify the main finding and implication of the data.
Verify that the learner is able to edit the text to ensure that it is free of grammatical errors and is written in the correct register.

Verify that the learner is able to write a formal letter to the editor of a newspaper in response to the article, demonstrating a clear understanding of the topic and the ability to write in a formal tone.
